summary: Stub package pulls install-script-bearing tarball from non-registry third-party host
details: merchantweb-lang-cookie-reset@2.0.0 is a stub package whose sole dependency is declared as a direct URL to a non-npm host (https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/npm/packet-table-thread-stream) rather than a registry-resolved package. The shrinkwrap pins the same URL and sets hasInstallScript: true, so npm install fetches an opaque tarball from artifacts.yosiroute.com and executes its lifecycle scripts on the installer's machine. The parent package itself has no other functionality; its only effect on install is to resolve and run the remote tarball's code. The tarball bytes are attacker-controllable (mutable URL, no registry integrity, no hash pin), giving whoever controls artifacts.yosiroute.com arbitrary code execution on every installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
